newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: CRICKET-SRI LANKA BREAK TEST RECORD WITH SCORE OF 952.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-SRI LANKA BREAK TEST RECORD WITH SCORE OF 952.

text.p: Sri Lanka broke the record for the highest innings total in test cricket when they scored 952 for six on the final day of the first test against India in Colombo on Wednesday. It bettered the 903 for seven England made against Australia at The Oval 59 years ago.
The longstanding record was broken during the final session of a match which saw just 14 wickets fall over five days.
However, the day was a personal disappointment for Sri Lanka opener Sanath Jayasuriya.
His attempt to break Trinidadian Brian Lara's world record score of 375 ended in failure when he was dismissed after adding just 14 runs to his overnight 326.
He was caught by Saurav Ganguly off Rajesh Chauhan in the fourth over of the day.
Jayasuriya's dismissal followed that of his longstanding partner Roshan Mahanama for 225 in the previous over. The pair put on 576 -- a record for any wicket in test cricket.
Jayasuriya's marathon 578-ball innings lasted 799 minutes and included 36 fours and two sixes. It was the fourth highest innings in tests after Lara's 375, Garry Sobers' 365 and Len Hutton's 364.
